meaningEn: to make a decision; to take it upon oneself to decide

sentences.hanzi: 这么大的事，我可不敢一个人做主张。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 da4 de5 shi4, wo3 ke3 bu4 gan3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhu3 zhang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이렇게 큰일은 나는 감히 혼자 결정할 수 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: I do not dare make the decision on such an important matter by myself.

sentences.hanzi: 办理这项手续时，需要一位可靠的作保人。
sentences.pinyin: ban4 li3 zhe4 xiang4 shou3 xu4 shi2, xu1 yao4 yi2 wei4 ke3 kao4 de5 zuo4 bao3 ren2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 절차를 처리할 때는 믿을 만한 보증인 한 명이 필요하다.
sentences.meaningEn: A reliable guarantor is needed when handling this procedure.

meaningEn: to keep someone company; to accompany guests

sentences.hanzi: 今晚有贵客来访，你也一起作陪吧。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 wan3 you3 gui4 ke4 lai2 fang3, ni3 ye3 yi4 qi3 zuo4 pei2 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 오늘 밤 귀한 손님이 오시니 너도 함께 자리를 해라.
sentences.meaningEn: A distinguished guest is visiting tonight, so come and help keep them company.

meaningEn: heterodox ways; improper or unorthodox methods

sentences.hanzi: 做事还是要走正路，别总想着靠左道旁门取巧。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 hai2 shi4 yao4 zou3 zheng4 lu4, bie2 zong3 xiang3 zhe5 kao4 zuo3 dao4 pang2 men2 qu3 qiao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일은 역시 정당한 길로 해야지, 늘 편법으로 요행을 바라면 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: In doing things, one should follow the proper path instead of always trying to take shortcuts through improper methods.

meaningEn: to sit in consultation; to attend a clinic or shop in person
meaningKo: 직접 자리를 지키며 진료하다; 가게를 보다

sentences.hanzi: 这位老中医每周都会固定几天在药铺坐堂。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 lao3 zhong1 yi1 mei3 zhou1 dou1 hui4 gu4 ding4 ji3 tian1 zai4 yao4 pu4 zuo4 tang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 노중의는 매주 며칠씩 약방에서 직접 진료를 본다.
sentences.meaningEn: This veteran traditional Chinese doctor sits in consultation at the pharmacy on several fixed days each week.

sentences.hanzi: 学校以作育英才为己任，长期重视教育质量。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 yi3 zuo4 yu4 ying1 cai2 wei2 ji3 ren4, chang2 qi1 zhong4 shi4 jiao4 yu4 zhi4 liang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 학교는 인재 양성을 자신의 사명으로 여기며 오랫동안 교육의 질을 중시해 왔다.
sentences.meaningEn: The school regards cultivating outstanding talent as its mission and has long attached importance to educational quality.

meaningEn: to network; to set up a network

sentences.hanzi: 新办公室已经完成组网，很快就能投入使用。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 ban4 gong1 shi4 yi3 jing1 wan2 cheng2 zu3 wang3, hen3 kuai4 jiu4 neng2 tou2 ru4 shi3 yong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 새 사무실은 이미 네트워크 구축을 마쳐 곧 사용에 들어갈 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The new office has already completed network setup and can soon be put into use.

meaningEn: to put on an act for others to see
meaningKo: 남에게 보이려고 연기하다; 보여주기 식으로 하다

sentences.hanzi: 他那副样子更像是在做戏给人看，并不真诚。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 na4 fu4 yang4 zi5 geng4 xiang4 shi4 zai4 zuo4 xi4 gei3 ren2 kan4, bing4 bu4 zhen1 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 그런 모습은 남에게 보이려고 연기하는 것 같을 뿐 진심이 없어 보인다.
sentences.meaningEn: His manner looked more like he was putting on an act for others to see rather than being sincere.

meaningEn: to feel as if sitting or lying on pins and needles; extremely uneasy

sentences.hanzi: 事情没有结果之前，他一直坐卧针毡。
sentences.pinyin: shi4 qing2 mei2 you3 jie2 guo3 zhi1 qian2, ta1 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 wo4 zhen1 zhan1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일의 결과가 나오기 전까지 그는 내내 가시방석에 앉은 듯했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before the matter was resolved, he felt as if he were sitting on pins and needles the whole time.

meaningEn: to count as final; to serve as the standard

sentences.hanzi: 这份文件已经盖章，可以作准了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 fen4 wen2 jian4 yi3 jing1 gai4 zhang1, ke3 yi3 zuo4 zhun3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 문서는 이미 도장이 찍혔으니 기준으로 삼아도 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: This document has already been stamped and can now be taken as final.

sentences.hanzi: 在信息不完整的情况下，很难作出准确判断。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 xin4 xi1 bu4 wan2 zheng3 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4, hen3 nan2 zuo4 chu1 zhun3 que4 pan4 duan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 정보가 완전하지 않은 상황에서는 정확한 판단을 내리기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: It is difficult to make an accurate judgment when the information is incomplete.

meaningEn: division of labor among team members

sentences.hanzi: 只要把组员分工安排清楚，效率就会提高。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ba3 zu3 yuan2 fen1 gong1 an1 pai2 qing1 chu3, xiao4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 ti2 gao1.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원 분담만 분명히 정리해 두면 효율은 높아질 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the division of labor among team members is clearly arranged, efficiency will improve.

meaningEn: do one job and love that job; be devoted to whatever work one does
meaningKo: 무슨 일을 하든 그 일을 사랑하다; 맡은 일을 아끼다

sentences.hanzi: 父亲常说，做人要做一行爱一行。
sentences.pinyin: fu4 qin1 chang2 shuo1, zuo4 ren2 yao4 zuo4 yi4 hang2 ai4 yi4 hang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 아버지는 사람이면 무슨 일을 하든 그 일을 사랑해야 한다고 자주 말씀하셨다.
sentences.meaningEn: My father often said that one should love whatever line of work one is in.

meaningEn: to miss the right moment through inaction

sentences.hanzi: 如果迟迟不行动，就可能坐失时机。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 chi2 chi2 bu4 xing2 dong4, jiu4 ke3 neng2 zuo4 shi1 shi2 ji1.
sentences.meaningKo: 계속 행동하지 않으면 가만히 있다가 때를 놓칠 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: If one delays taking action, one may miss the right moment through inaction.

meaningEn: criminal motive; motive for committing the crime

sentences.hanzi: 警方正在调查嫌疑人的作案动机。
sentences.pinyin: jing3 fang1 zheng4 zai4 diao4 cha2 xian2 yi2 ren2 de5 zuo4 an4 dong4 ji1.
sentences.meaningKo: 경찰은 용의자의 범행 동기를 조사하고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The police are investigating the suspect’s motive for committing the crime.

sentences.hanzi: 设备已经组装完成，可以开始调试了。
sentences.pinyin: she4 bei4 yi3 jing1 zu3 zhuang1 wan2 cheng2, ke3 yi3 kai1 shi3 tiao2 shi4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 장비는 이미 조립이 끝났으니 조정을 시작해도 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: The equipment has already been assembled, and testing can now begin.

sentences.hanzi: 面对市场变化，企业不能坐以待变。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 shi4 chang3 bian4 hua4, qi4 ye4 bu4 neng2 zuo4 yi3 dai4 bian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 시장 변화를 마주했을 때 기업은 가만히 앉아 변화만 기다려서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When facing market changes, enterprises cannot simply wait passively for things to change.

sentences.hanzi: 整个作战部署经过反复推敲，已经相当完善。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 zuo4 zhan4 bu4 shu3 jing1 guo4 fan3 fu4 tui1 qiao1, yi3 jing1 xiang1 dang1 wan2 shan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 작전 배치는 여러 차례 검토를 거쳐 상당히 완비되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The entire operational deployment has been repeatedly refined and is now fairly complete.

sentences.hanzi: 这道作图题看起来简单，其实很考验细心。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 zuo4 tu2 ti2 kan4 qi3 lai2 jian3 dan1, qi2 shi2 hen3 kao3 yan4 xi4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작도 문제는 겉보기에 단순하지만 사실은 세심함을 많이 요구한다.
sentences.meaningEn: This graphing problem looks simple, but it actually requires great care.

meaningEn: to sit on; to sit down onto

sentences.hanzi: 椅子刚擦过，先别急着坐上去。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 zi5 gang1 ca1 guo4, xian1 bie2 ji2 zhe5 zuo4 shang4 qu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 의자를 방금 닦았으니 먼저 서둘러 그 위에 앉지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: The chair was just wiped, so do not sit down on it in a hurry.

meaningEn: to make a sample; to prepare a sample

sentences.hanzi: 正式生产前，我们要先做几个样本看看效果。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 sheng1 chan3 qian2, wo3 men5 yao4 xian1 zuo4 ji3 ge4 yang4 ben3 kan4 kan5 xiao4 guo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 정식 생산 전에 우리는 먼저 몇 개의 샘플을 만들어 효과를 봐야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before formal production, we need to make a few samples first to see the results.

meaningEn: manuscript solicitation ends; submission collection completed

sentences.hanzi: 本期专题的组稿已经结束，接下来进入编辑阶段。
sentences.pinyin: ben3 qi1 zhuan1 ti2 de5 zu3 gao3 yi3 jing1 jie2 shu4, jie1 xia4 lai2 jin4 ru4 bian1 ji2 jie1 duan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 특집의 원고 모집은 이미 끝났고 이제 편집 단계로 들어간다.
sentences.meaningEn: The manuscript solicitation for this special issue has ended, and it is now entering the editing stage.

meaningEn: decision-maker; the person who has the final say

sentences.hanzi: 这件事情还得请真正作主的人来拍板。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 qing2 hai2 dei3 qing3 zhen1 zheng4 zuo4 zhu3 de5 ren2 lai2 pai1 ban3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 일은 역시 진짜 결정권자가 와서 최종 결정을 내려야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: For this matter, the real decision-maker still needs to come and make the final call.

sentences.hanzi: 出了门往前走，第二个路口左拐就到了。
sentences.pinyin: chu1 le5 men2 wang3 qian2 zou3, di4 er4 ge4 lu4 kou3 zuo3 guai3 jiu4 dao4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 문을 나가 앞으로 걷다가 두 번째 교차로에서 왼쪽으로 꺾으면 도착한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Go straight after leaving the door, and turn left at the second intersection to arrive.

sentences.hanzi: 良好的作战指挥能够大大提升整体配合效率。
sentences.pinyin: liang2 hao3 de5 zuo4 zhan4 zhi3 hui1 neng2 gou4 da4 da4 ti2 sheng1 zheng3 ti3 pei4 he2 xiao4 lv4.
sentences.meaningKo: 좋은 작전 지휘는 전체 협조 효율을 크게 높일 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Good operational command can greatly improve overall coordination efficiency.

sentences.hanzi: 我们先坐下来，好好把这件事谈清楚。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 zuo4 xia4 lai2, hao3 hao3 ba3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 tan2 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 우리 먼저 앉아서 이 일을 차근차근 분명히 이야기하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Let us sit down first and talk this matter through clearly.

meaningEn: to do problems; to answer questions

sentences.hanzi: 做题时要先看清要求，再动笔。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 ti2 shi2 yao4 xian1 kan4 qing1 yao1 qiu2, zai4 dong4 bi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제를 풀 때는 먼저 요구 사항을 분명히 보고 나서 펜을 들어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing problems, you should first read the requirements carefully before writing.

sentences.hanzi: 这些作证材料需要妥善保存，以备后续核查。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 zuo4 zheng4 cai2 liao4 xu1 yao4 tuo3 shan4 bao3 cun2, yi3 bei4 hou4 xu4 he2 cha2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 증언 자료들은 후속 확인에 대비해 잘 보관해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: These testimonial materials need to be properly preserved for subsequent verification.

sentences.hanzi: 有问题的话，可以先向组长反映。
sentences.pinyin: you3 wen4 ti2 de5 hua4, ke3 yi3 xian1 xiang4 zu3 zhang3 fan3 ying4.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제가 있으면 먼저 조장에게 이야기하면 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: If there is a problem, you can report it to the group leader first.

meaningEn: to stay in the rear directing operations

sentences.hanzi: 他负责坐镇后方，统筹各方面的协调工作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 fu4 ze2 zuo4 zhen4 hou4 fang1, tong3 chou2 ge4 fang1 mian4 de5 xie2 tiao2 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 후방에서 지휘하며 각 방면의 조정 업무를 총괄했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He was responsible for staying in the rear and coordinating work in all aspects.

meaningEn: to make a promise; to give an assurance; to guarantee

sentences.hanzi: 他当着大家的面做保证，以后绝不再犯同样的错误。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dang1 zhe5 da4 jia1 de5 mian4 zuo4 bao3 zheng4, yi3 hou4 jue2 bu2 zai4 fan4 tong2 yang4 de5 cuo4 wu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 모두 앞에서 앞으로는 같은 실수를 절대 다시 하지 않겠다고 약속했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He gave his assurance in front of everyone that he would never make the same mistake again.

sentences.hanzi: 为了尽快达成一致，双方都作出了一些让步。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 jin3 kuai4 da2 cheng2 yi2 zhi4, shuang1 fang1 dou1 zuo4 chu1 le5 yi4 xie1 rang4 bu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 빨리 합의에 이르기 위해 양측 모두 어느 정도 양보했다.
sentences.meaningEn: In order to reach an agreement quickly, both sides made some concessions.

sentences.hanzi: 警方已经封锁了作案现场，正在进行勘查。
sentences.pinyin: jing3 fang1 yi3 jing1 feng1 suo3 le5 zuo4 an4 xian4 chang3, zheng4 zai4 jin4 xing2 kan1 cha2.
sentences.meaningKo: 경찰은 이미 범행 현장을 봉쇄하고 현재 감식을 진행하고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The police have already sealed off the crime scene and are conducting an investigation.

meaningEn: submission deadline; manuscript solicitation period limit

sentences.hanzi: 请大家注意，本次专题的组稿期限到本月底为止。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4, ben3 ci4 zhuan1 ti2 de5 zu3 gao3 qi1 xian4 dao4 ben3 yue4 di3 wei2 zhi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 주의해 주세요. 이번 특집의 원고 모집 기한은 이번 달 말까지입니다.
sentences.meaningEn: Please note that the submission deadline for this special issue is the end of this month.

meaningEn: to be sidelined; to be left out in the cold

sentences.hanzi: 刚开始没人注意他，他也只能先坐冷板凳。
sentences.pinyin: gang1 kai1 shi3 mei2 ren2 zhu4 yi4 ta1, ta1 ye3 zhi3 neng2 xian1 zuo4 leng3 ban3 deng4.
sentences.meaningKo: 처음에는 아무도 그를 주목하지 않아 그도 우선 찬밥 신세가 될 수밖에 없었다.
sentences.meaningEn: At first no one paid attention to him, so he could only remain sidelined for a while.

sentences.hanzi: 他最近压力太大，晚上总是做恶梦。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zui4 jin4 ya1 li4 tai4 da4, wan3 shang4 zong3 shi4 zuo4 e4 meng4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 요즘 스트레스가 너무 커서 밤마다 늘 악몽을 꾼다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has been under too much pressure recently, so he keeps having nightmares at night.

sentences.hanzi: 只有严格按照作业标准执行，才能保证质量稳定。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yan2 ge2 an4 zhao4 zuo4 ye4 biao1 zhun3 zhi2 xing2, cai2 neng2 bao3 zheng4 zhi4 liang4 wen3 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 엄격하게 작업 기준에 따라 시행해야만 품질의 안정성을 보장할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only by strictly following the work standards can stable quality be ensured.

sentences.hanzi: 逢年过节，左邻右里都会互相送些小礼物。
sentences.pinyin: feng2 nian2 guo4 jie2, zuo3 lin2 you4 li3 dou1 hui4 hu4 xiang1 song4 xie1 xiao3 li3 wu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 명절이 되면 이웃 사람들은 서로 작은 선물을 주고받곤 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: During festivals, neighbors often exchange small gifts with one another.

sentences.hanzi: 这些零件很精密，组装的时候一定要小心。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 ling2 jian4 hen3 jing1 mi4, zu3 zhuang1 de5 shi2 hou4 yi2 ding4 yao4 xiao3 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 부품들은 매우 정밀하니 조립할 때 반드시 조심해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: These parts are very precise, so you must be careful when assembling them.

meaningEn: compositional inspiration; inspiration for composing music

sentences.hanzi: 他常常在散步时突然获得作曲灵感。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 chang2 chang2 zai4 san4 bu4 shi2 tu1 ran2 huo4 de2 zuo4 qu3 ling2 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 산책할 때 갑자기 작곡 영감을 얻는 일이 자주 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: He often suddenly gets inspiration for composition while taking a walk.

meaningEn: to make into; to accomplish; to complete successfully

sentences.hanzi: 只要大家齐心协力，这件事一定能做成。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 da4 jia1 qi2 xin1 xie2 li4, zhe4 jian4 shi4 yi2 ding4 neng2 zuo4 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 힘을 합치기만 하면 이 일은 반드시 해낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as everyone works together, this matter can definitely be accomplished.

meaningEn: to set oneself against; to become rivals

sentences.hanzi: 他们从小就喜欢作对头，谁也不让谁。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 cong2 xiao3 jiu4 xi3 huan1 zuo4 dui4 tou2, shui2 ye3 bu2 rang4 shui2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그들은 어릴 때부터 서로 맞서기를 좋아해서 누구도 누구에게 지지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: They had liked opposing each other since childhood, and neither would give way to the other.

meaningEn: unable to rest either sitting or lying down; deeply uneasy
meaningKo: 앉아도 누워도 편치 않다; 몹시 불안하다

sentences.hanzi: 孩子还没回来，母亲急得坐卧不宁。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 hai2 mei2 hui2 lai2, mu3 qin1 ji2 de5 zuo4 wo4 bu4 ning2.
sentences.meaningKo: 아이가 아직 돌아오지 않아서 어머니는 앉아도 누워도 편치 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: The child had not returned yet, and the mother was so anxious that she could neither sit nor lie in peace.

meaningEn: to carry through to the end; to persist to the finish

sentences.hanzi: 既然决定开始，就要有勇气把它做到底。
sentences.pinyin: ji4 ran2 jue2 ding4 kai1 shi3, jiu4 yao4 you3 yong3 qi4 ba3 ta1 zuo4 dao4 di3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이미 시작하기로 결정했다면 그것을 끝까지 해낼 용기가 있어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Since you have decided to begin, you should have the courage to carry it through to the end.

sentences.hanzi: 请在今天下午之前把组员名单交上来。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 zai4 jin1 tian1 xia4 wu3 zhi1 qian2 ba3 zu3 yuan2 ming2 dan1 jiao1 shang4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 오늘 오후 전까지 조원 명단을 제출해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please hand in the team member list before this afternoon.

meaningEn: to engage in academic study; to do scholarship

sentences.hanzi: 做学问不能只图快，更要讲求严谨。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 xue2 wen4 bu4 neng2 zhi3 tu2 kuai4, geng4 yao4 jiang3 qiu2 yan2 jin3.
sentences.meaningKo: 학문을 하는 데에는 빠르기만을 추구해서는 안 되고 더욱 엄밀함을 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: In doing scholarship, one cannot seek speed alone; one must value rigor even more.

meaningEn: to sit up waiting for dawn; to await eagerly and restlessly
meaningKo: 뜬눈으로 새벽을 기다리다; 초조하게 밤을 새우다

sentences.hanzi: 事情关系重大，他一夜坐而待旦，几乎没合眼。
sentences.pinyin: shi4 qing2 guan1 xi4 zhong4 da4, ta1 yi2 ye4 zuo4 er2 dai4 dan4, ji1 hu1 mei2 he2 yan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일이 매우 중대해서 그는 밤새 뜬눈으로 새벽을 기다리며 거의 잠을 이루지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The matter was of great importance, so he sat up waiting for dawn all night and hardly slept at all.

meaningEn: to take notes; to make a record

sentences.hanzi: 开会的时候请安排一个人专门做记录。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 de5 shi2 hou4 qing3 an1 pai2 yi2 ge4 ren2 zhuan1 men2 zuo4 ji4 lu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의할 때는 한 사람을 따로 정해 기록을 맡기세요.
sentences.meaningEn: During the meeting, please arrange for one person to take notes specifically.

sentences.hanzi: 做决定之前，最好先听听每位组员的意见。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 jue2 ding4 zhi1 qian2, zui4 hao3 xian1 ting1 ting1 mei3 wei4 zu3 yuan2 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 결정을 내리기 전에 각 조원의 의견을 먼저 들어 보는 것이 가장 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before making a decision, it is best to first hear the opinions of each team member.

meaningEn: to sit by and watch; to look on passively

sentences.hanzi: 看到问题不断扩大，我们不能继续坐视。
sentences.pinyin: kan4 dao4 wen4 ti2 bu4 duan4 kuo4 da4, wo3 men5 bu4 neng2 ji4 xu4 zuo4 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제가 계속 커지는 것을 보면서 우리는 더 이상 방관할 수 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: Seeing the problem continue to grow, we can no longer simply sit by and watch.

meaningEn: showmanship element; element of putting on a show

sentences.hanzi: 这场活动虽然有点作秀成分，但也确实带来了关注。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 huo2 dong4 sui1 ran2 you3 dian3 zuo4 xiu4 cheng2 fen4, dan4 ye3 que4 shi2 dai4 lai2 le5 guan1 zhu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 행사는 다소 보여주기식 요소가 있기는 했지만 실제로 관심을 끌어오기도 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Although this event had a bit of a showmanship element, it did indeed bring attention.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for news

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐等消息，不如主动去确认情况。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 deng3 xiao1 xi5, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 qu4 que4 ren4 qing2 kuang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그저 소식을 가만히 기다리기보다는 적극적으로 상황을 확인하러 가는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for news, it is better to take the initiative to confirm the situation.

meaningEn: timetable of work and rest; daily schedule

sentences.hanzi: 新的作息时间表已经贴在公告栏上了。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 de5 zuo4 xi1 shi2 jian1 biao3 yi3 jing1 tie1 zai4 gong1 gao4 lan2 shang4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 새로운 생활 시간표는 이미 게시판에 붙어 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The new daily schedule has already been posted on the bulletin board.

sentences.hanzi: 认真求实，是做学问的基本态度。
sentences.pinyin: ren4 zhen1 qiu2 shi2, shi4 zuo4 xue2 wen4 de5 ji1 ben3 tai4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 진지하고 사실을 추구하는 것은 학문하는 기본 태도이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Seriousness and seeking truth are the basic attitudes required for scholarship.

sentences.hanzi: 这项活动鼓励大家组队参加，互相配合。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xiang4 huo2 dong4 gu3 li4 da4 jia1 zu3 dui4 can1 jia1, hu4 xiang1 pei4 he2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 활동은 모두가 팀을 이뤄 참가하여 서로 협력하도록 장려한다.
sentences.meaningEn: This activity encourages everyone to participate as a team and cooperate with one another.

meaningEn: able to sit still; able to stay put patiently
meaningKo: 가만히 잘 앉아 있다; 차분히 버티다

sentences.hanzi: 做研究的人首先得坐得住，耐得下性子。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 yan2 jiu1 de5 ren2 shou3 xian1 dei3 zuo4 de5 zhu4, nai4 de5 xia4 xing4 zi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 연구하는 사람은 무엇보다 먼저 차분히 자리를 지키고 성질을 견딜 수 있어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: People who do research must first of all be able to sit still and remain patient.

meaningEn: to do handicrafts; to make things by hand

sentences.hanzi: 她从小就喜欢做手工，动手能力很强。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 xiao3 jiu4 xi3 huan1 zuo4 shou3 gong1, dong4 shou3 neng2 li4 hen3 qiang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 어릴 때부터 수공예를 좋아해서 손재주가 매우 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: She has liked doing handicrafts since childhood and is very skillful with her hands.

meaningEn: criminal tool; instrument used in committing a crime

sentences.hanzi: 警方在现场找到了嫌疑人遗留的作案工具。
sentences.pinyin: jing3 fang1 zai4 xian4 chang3 zhao3 dao4 le5 xian2 yi2 ren2 yi2 liu2 de5 zuo4 an4 gong1 ju4.
sentences.meaningKo: 경찰은 현장에서 용의자가 남긴 범행 도구를 찾아냈다.
sentences.meaningEn: The police found the crime tool left behind by the suspect at the scene.

sentences.hanzi: 临近截稿时，组稿工作量会明显增加。
sentences.pinyin: lin2 jin4 jie2 gao3 shi2, zu3 gao3 gong1 zuo4 liang4 hui4 ming2 xian3 zeng1 jia1.
sentences.meaningKo: 마감이 가까워질수록 원고 모집 업무량은 눈에 띄게 늘어난다.
sentences.meaningEn: As the deadline approaches, the workload of manuscript solicitation increases noticeably.

meaningEn: to command from the center; to preside from the central position

sentences.hanzi: 总负责人坐镇中央，统一协调各个小组的工作。
sentences.pinyin: zong3 fu4 ze2 ren2 zuo4 zhen4 zhong1 yang1, tong3 yi1 xie2 tiao2 ge4 ge4 xiao3 zu3 de5 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 총책임자는 중앙에서 지휘하며 각 소조의 업무를 통일적으로 조정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The chief person in charge directed from the center and coordinated the work of all the groups in a unified way.

sentences.hanzi: 上课时认真做笔记，有助于课后复习。
sentences.pinyin: shang4 ke4 shi2 ren4 zhen1 zuo4 bi3 ji4, you3 zhu4 yu2 ke4 hou4 fu4 xi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 수업 시간에 성실하게 필기하면 수업 후 복습에 도움이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Taking notes carefully in class helps with review afterward.

meaningEn: to add supplementary remarks; to supplement

sentences.hanzi: 如果还有遗漏的地方，请你再作补充。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 hai2 you3 yi2 lou4 de5 di4 fang1, qing3 ni3 zai4 zuo4 bu3 chong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 혹시 빠진 부분이 있으면 다시 보충해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: If there is anything still missing, please add some supplementary remarks.

meaningEn: to sit upright; to sit properly

sentences.hanzi: 开会的时候请大家坐得端正一些。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 de5 shi2 hou4 qing3 da4 jia1 zuo4 de5 duan1 zheng4 yi4 xie1.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의할 때는 모두 조금 더 바르게 앉아 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please sit a bit more upright during the meeting.

meaningEn: to use as reference; for reference

sentences.hanzi: 这份资料你可以先拿去作参考。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 fen4 zi1 liao4 ni3 ke3 yi3 xian1 na2 qu4 zuo4 can1 kao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 자료는 먼저 가져가 참고로 삼아도 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: You can take this material first and use it as a reference.

sentences.hanzi: 每周一早上我们都会开一次组会。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 zhou1 yi1 zao3 shang4 wo3 men5 dou1 hui4 kai1 yi2 ci4 zu3 hui4.
sentences.meaningKo: 우리는 매주 월요일 아침마다 조 모임을 한 번 연다.
sentences.meaningEn: We hold a group meeting every Monday morning.

meaningEn: one remark after another from different sides; interrupting with scattered comments
meaningKo: 이 말 저 말 하다; 여기저기서 한마디씩 하다

sentences.hanzi: 大家左一句右一句，讨论得特别热烈。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zuo3 yi2 ju4 you4 yi2 ju4, tao3 lun4 de5 te4 bie2 re4 lie4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 이 말 저 말 보태며 아주 열띠게 토론했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone chimed in one after another, and the discussion became especially lively.

sentences.hanzi: 负责人已经提前把明天的工作都做了安排。
sentences.pinyin: fu4 ze2 ren2 yi3 jing1 ti2 qian2 ba3 ming2 tian1 de5 gong1 zuo4 dou1 zuo4 le5 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 책임자는 내일 일을 이미 미리 모두 안배해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The person in charge has already made arrangements in advance for tomorrow’s work.

meaningEn: unable to sit steadily; unstable in position

sentences.hanzi: 消息一传开，他这个位置恐怕就坐不稳了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao1 xi5 yi4 chuan2 kai1, ta1 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi5 kong3 pa4 jiu4 zuo4 bu4 wen3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 소식이 퍼지면 그의 이 자리는 아마 지키기 어려워질 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Once the news spreads, he will probably no longer be secure in his position.

meaningEn: to explain; to give an explanation

sentences.hanzi: 对于大家的疑问，他当场作了解释。
sentences.pinyin: dui4 yu2 da4 jia1 de5 yi2 wen4, ta1 dang1 chang3 zuo4 le5 jie3 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 모두의 의문에 대해 그 자리에서 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He gave an explanation on the spot regarding everyone’s doubts.

meaningKo: 과제 요구 사항; 작업 요구 사항

sentences.hanzi: 请大家先看清楚作业要求，再开始动手。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 da4 jia1 xian1 kan4 qing1 chu3 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2, zai4 kai1 shi3 dong4 shou3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 과제 요구 사항을 분명히 확인한 뒤 시작하세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please first read the assignment requirements carefully before getting started.

meaningEn: to put on a show for others; to do things just for appearance

sentences.hanzi: 做事不能只是做样子给别人看，关键还是实际效果。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 bu4 neng2 zhi3 shi4 zuo4 yang4 zi5 gei3 bie2 ren2 kan4, guan1 jian4 hai2 shi4 shi2 ji4 xiao4 guo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일은 남에게 보이기 위해 형식만 취해서는 안 되고 핵심은 실제 효과에 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: In doing things, one cannot merely put on a show for others; what matters is the actual effect.

sentences.hanzi: 项目经理每天都会检查一下作业进度。
sentences.pinyin: xiang4 mu4 jing1 li3 mei3 tian1 dou1 hui4 jian3 cha2 yi2 xia4 zuo4 ye4 jin4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 프로젝트 매니저는 매일 작업 진도를 한 번씩 점검한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The project manager checks the work progress every day.

meaningEn: to have enough room to sit; to be able to sit down
meaningKo: 앉을 자리가 있다; 앉을 수 있다

sentences.hanzi: 这张长椅再坐两个人也坐得下。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhang1 chang2 yi3 zai4 zuo4 liang3 ge4 ren2 ye3 zuo4 de5 xia4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 긴 의자는 두 사람이 더 앉아도 자리가 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: This long bench still has room for two more people to sit.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible; to be led by the group leader

sentences.hanzi: 这部分内容由组长负责统筹和检查。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 fen4 nei4 rong2 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 tong3 chou2 he2 jian3 cha2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 부분 내용은 조장이 총괄하고 점검하는 책임을 맡는다.
sentences.meaningEn: This part is the responsibility of the group leader for overall coordination and inspection.

meaningEn: slack in style; undisciplined in manner

sentences.hanzi: 如果作风散漫，再好的计划也难以落实。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zuo4 feng1 san3 man4, zai4 hao3 de5 ji4 hua4 ye3 nan2 yi3 luo4 shi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 태도가 해이하면 아무리 좋은 계획도 실행하기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: If one’s style is slack, even the best plans are hard to carry out.

meaningEn: to accomplish something; to get something done

sentences.hanzi: 想真正做成一件事，光有热情还不够。
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 zhen1 zheng4 zuo4 cheng2 yi2 jian4 shi4, guang1 you3 re4 qing2 hai2 bu4 gou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 정말로 일 하나를 해내려면 열정만 있어서는 부족하다.
sentences.meaningEn: If one truly wants to accomplish something, enthusiasm alone is not enough.

sentences.hanzi: 监控录像帮助警方锁定了大致的作案时间。
sentences.pinyin: jian1 kong4 lu4 xiang4 bang1 zhu4 jing3 fang1 suo3 ding4 le5 da4 zhi4 de5 zuo4 an4 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 감시 영상은 경찰이 대략적인 범행 시간을 특정하는 데 도움을 주었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The surveillance footage helped the police determine the approximate time of the crime.

meaningEn: direction of manuscript solicitation; editorial direction

sentences.hanzi: 在正式发通知之前，先要确定组稿方向。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zheng4 shi4 fa1 tong1 zhi1 zhi1 qian2, xian1 yao4 que4 ding4 zu3 gao3 fang1 xiang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 공식 공지를 내기 전에 먼저 원고 모집 방향을 정해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before issuing the formal notice, the direction of manuscript solicitation must first be determined.

meaningEn: to do wrongly; to make a mistake

sentences.hanzi: 如果做错了，就要及时承认并改正。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zuo4 cuo4 le5, jiu4 yao4 ji2 shi2 cheng2 ren4 bing4 gai3 zheng4.
sentences.meaningKo: 잘못했다면 제때 인정하고 바로잡아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you did something wrong, you should admit it promptly and correct it.

sentences.hanzi: 请把有关情况整理成书面作证说明。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ba3 you3 guan1 qing2 kuang4 zheng3 li3 cheng2 shu1 mian4 zuo4 zheng4 shuo1 ming2.
sentences.meaningKo: 관련 상황을 정리해 서면 증언 설명으로 작성해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please organize the relevant circumstances into a written testimonial statement.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the result

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐等结果，不如主动跟进进展。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 deng3 jie2 guo3, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 gen1 jin4 jin4 zhan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 결과만 가만히 기다리기보다는 적극적으로 진행 상황을 따라가는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than just sitting and waiting for the result, it is better to follow up actively on the progress.

sentences.hanzi: 整个作战行动需要保持高度配合。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 zuo4 zhan4 xing2 dong4 xu1 yao4 bao3 chi2 gao1 du4 pei4 he2.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 작전 행동은 높은 수준의 협조를 유지해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The entire operation requires a high degree of coordination.

sentences.hanzi: 通过组员讨论，我们把方案又完善了一些。
sentences.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zu3 yuan2 tao3 lun4, wo3 men5 ba3 fang1 an4 you4 wan2 shan4 le5 yi4 xie1.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원 토론을 통해 우리는 방안을 조금 더 보완했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Through discussion among the team members, we improved the plan a bit further.

sentences.hanzi: 进入作业面之前，要先检查安全情况。
sentences.pinyin: jin4 ru4 zuo4 ye4 mian4 zhi1 qian2, yao4 xian1 jian3 cha2 an1 quan2 qing2 kuang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업면에 들어가기 전에 먼저 안전 상황을 점검해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before entering the work face, one must first check the safety conditions.

sentences.hanzi: 要想坐稳位置，光靠运气是不够的。
sentences.pinyin: yao4 xiang3 zuo4 wen3 wei4 zhi5, guang1 kao4 yun4 qi5 shi4 bu4 gou4 de5.
sentences.meaningKo: 자리를 굳히려면 운에만 기대서는 부족하다.
sentences.meaningEn: If one wants to secure one’s position, relying on luck alone is not enough.

sentences.hanzi: 要先查清楚是不是有人在背后做手脚。
sentences.pinyin: yao4 xian1 cha2 qing1 chu3 shi4 bu2 shi4 you3 ren2 zai4 bei4 hou4 zuo4 shou3 jiao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 누군가 뒤에서 수작을 부리고 있는지 먼저 분명히 조사해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: We must first find out clearly whether someone is tampering behind the scenes.

meaningEn: formation completed; to finish setting up

sentences.hanzi: 新部门已经组建完成，下周开始正式运行。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 bu4 men2 yi3 jing1 zu3 jian4 wan2 cheng2, xia4 zhou1 kai1 shi3 zheng4 shi4 yun4 xing2.
sentences.meaningKo: 새 부서는 이미 구성이 완료되어 다음 주부터 정식 운영에 들어간다.
sentences.meaningEn: The new department has already been fully set up and will begin formal operation next week.

meaningEn: disordered routine; imbalance in work-rest schedule

sentences.hanzi: 长期加班容易导致作息失调。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 qi1 jia1 ban1 rong2 yi4 dao3 zhi4 zuo4 xi1 shi1 tiao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 장기간 야근하면 생활 리듬이 깨지기 쉽다.
sentences.meaningEn: Working overtime for a long time easily leads to a disrupted routine.

sentences.hanzi: 遇到大事时，不能只凭情绪做决定。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 da4 shi4 shi2, bu4 neng2 zhi3 ping2 qing2 xu4 zuo4 jue2 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 큰일을 만났을 때는 감정만으로 결정해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When facing important matters, one should not make decisions based only on emotion.

meaningEn: to be on site directing; to oversee at the scene

sentences.hanzi: 为了确保流程顺畅，他全程坐镇现场。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 que4 bao3 liu2 cheng2 shun4 chang4, ta1 quan2 cheng2 zuo4 zhen4 xian4 chang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 절차가 순조롭도록 그는 전 과정 동안 현장을 지키며 지휘했다.
sentences.meaningEn: To ensure the process ran smoothly, he oversaw the scene throughout the entire process.

meaningEn: improper way of handling; inappropriate approach

sentences.hanzi: 这件事之所以引起争议，主要还是因为做法不当。

sentences.meaningEn: He is rigorous in his work style, so everyone is willing to entrust important tasks to him.

meaningEn: in-group discussion; discussion within the team

sentences.hanzi: 在正式汇报之前，我们先进行了充分的组内讨论。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zheng4 shi4 hui4 bao4 zhi1 qian2, wo3 men5 xian1 jin4 xing2 le5 chong1 fen4 de5 zu3 nei4 tao3 lun4.

sentences.meaningEn: Before the formal presentation, we first carried out a thorough in-group discussion.

sentences.hanzi: 今天的作业任务比较重，大家得抓紧时间。

sentences.meaningEn: Today's work task is relatively heavy, so everyone needs to make good use of the time.

meaningEn: to be sidelined for many years

sentences.hanzi: 他虽然坐冷板凳多年，但始终没有放弃自己的方向。

sentences.meaningEn: Although he had been sidelined for many years, he never gave up on his own direction.

sentences.hanzi: 作为组长，他应该先做出表率。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 zu3 zhang3, ta1 ying1 gai1 xian1 zuo4 chu1 biao3 shuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장으로서 그는 먼저 모범을 보여야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: As the group leader, he should be the first to set an example.

sentences.hanzi: 良好的作业环境能有效提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: liang2 hao3 de5 zuo4 ye4 huan2 jing4 neng2 you3 xiao4 ti2 gao1 gong1 zuo4 xiao4 lv4.
sentences.meaningKo: 좋은 작업 환경은 업무 효율을 효과적으로 높일 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: A good working environment can effectively improve work efficiency.

sentences.meaningEn: When facing problems, you cannot just sit still; you must actively think of solutions.

meaningEn: to give a response; to respond

sentences.hanzi: 对于外界的质疑，公司已经正式作出回应。

sentences.meaningKo: 외부의 의문 제기에 대해 회사는 이미 정식으로 대응했다.

meaningEn: group leader's arrangement; arranged by the group leader

sentences.meaningKo: 구체적인 임무는 이미 조장이 잘 배정해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The specific tasks have already been arranged by the group leader.

meaningEn: to do practical things; to do real work

sentences.hanzi: 与其空谈，不如脚踏实地做实事。

sentences.meaningEn: This matter has dragged on for too long, and today it must be brought to a conclusion.

sentences.hanzi: 这次专题的组稿范围比以往更广。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zhuan1 ti2 de5 zu3 gao3 fan4 wei2 bi3 yi3 wang3 geng4 guang3.

meaningEn: to be used to abusing power arrogantly

sentences.meaningEn: Some people are so used to abusing power arrogantly that it is hard for them to listen to others’ opinions.

meaningEn: to work; to do persuasion or liaison work

sentences.meaningKo: 행동을 시작하기 전에 먼저 작전 목표를 분명히 해야 한다.

meaningEn: scholarship values rigor; doing research requires rigor

sentences.meaningEn: When we see others in difficulty, we must not sit by and ignore it.

meaningEn: group leader's summary; summary by the group leader

sentences.hanzi: 从这里去学校，坐公交车最方便。

sentences.hanzi: 改进流程以后，作业效率明显提高了。

sentences.meaningKo: 절차를 개선한 뒤 작업 효율이 눈에 띄게 높아졌다.

sentences.pinyin: lu4 cheng2 you3 dian3 yuan3, wo3 men5 hai2 shi4 zuo4 che1 qu4 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 거리가 좀 머니 우리는 역시 차를 타고 가는 게 낫다.

sentences.meaningKo: 서로 다른 방안을 마주했을 때 우리는 냉정하게 선택해야 한다.

sentences.hanzi: 先把设计图做成样品，再决定是否量产。

sentences.meaningEn: Let us first turn the design into a sample, and then decide whether to mass-produce it.

sentences.hanzi: 只有充分做好作战准备，行动才更有把握。

sentences.meaningKo: 충분히 작전 준비를 마쳐야만 행동에 더 자신을 가질 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only by making thorough operational preparations can the action be carried out with greater confidence.

sentences.meaningKo: 최종 결과는 조직위원회 결정을 기준으로 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The final result shall be based on the decision of the organizing committee.

sentences.hanzi: 假期里作息混乱，开学后需要慢慢调整回来。

sentences.meaningEn: The routine became chaotic during the vacation, so it needs to be gradually adjusted back after school starts.

meaningEn: serious and conscientious in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事认真，所以很少出现差错。

meaningEn: to sit in the front row

sentences.hanzi: 如果想看得更清楚，就早点去坐前排。

sentences.meaningEn: Filling in the work log in time every day helps with follow-up tracking.

meaningEn: to make a self-criticism; to write a review of one's mistake

sentences.hanzi: 犯了错误以后，他主动做了检讨。
sentences.pinyin: fan4 le5 cuo4 wu4 yi3 hou4, ta1 zhu3 dong4 zuo4 le5 jian3 tao3.

sentences.meaningEn: After each team member speaks, everyone may ask questions or add supplementary remarks.

meaningEn: plain and practical in style; unpretentious

sentences.meaningEn: His style is plain and practical, and he never speaks in exaggerated terms.

meaningEn: to take a tram / trolley car

sentences.meaningEn: We need to arrange working time reasonably and avoid putting things off until the last minute.

meaningEn: to do preparatory work; to make preliminary preparations

sentences.hanzi: 在正式开始之前，大家先把准备工作做好。

meaningEn: to decide; to take the final responsibility for deciding

sentences.hanzi: 路程太远了，我们还是坐飞机去吧。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 cheng2 tai4 yuan3 le5, wo3 men5 hai2 shi4 zuo4 fei1 ji1 qu4 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 거리가 너무 머니 우리는 역시 비행기를 타고 가는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: The distance is too far, so we had better go by plane.

meaningEn: work成果; results of the work

sentences.hanzi: 大家对这次的作业成果都很满意。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dui4 zhe4 ci4 de5 zuo4 ye4 cheng2 guo3 dou1 hen3 man3 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 이번 작업 성과에 매우 만족했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone was very satisfied with the results of this work.

sentences.hanzi: 长期训练有助于提高作曲能力。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 qi1 xun4 lian4 you3 zhu4 yu2 ti2 gao1 zuo4 qu3 neng2 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 장기적인 훈련은 작곡 능력을 높이는 데 도움이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Long-term training helps improve compositional ability.

meaningEn: unable to sit calmly; uneasy and restless

sentences.hanzi: 一有风吹草动，他就坐不安稳。
sentences.pinyin: yi4 you3 feng1 chui1 cao3 dong4, ta1 jiu4 zuo4 bu4 an1 wen3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조금만 이상한 낌새가 있어도 그는 불안해 가만히 있지 못한다.
sentences.meaningEn: At the slightest sign of trouble, he becomes too uneasy to sit calmly.

sentences.hanzi: 做出决定后，就不要再反复犹豫了。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 jue2 ding4 hou4, jiu4 bu2 yao4 zai4 fan3 fu4 you2 yu4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 결정을 내린 뒤에는 더 이상 반복해서 망설이지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: After making a decision, do not keep hesitating over it again and again.

sentences.hanzi: 技术人员正在现场组装设备。
sentences.pinyin: ji4 shu4 ren2 yuan2 zheng4 zai4 xian4 chang3 zu3 zhuang1 she4 bei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 기술 인원들이 현장에서 장비를 조립하고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The technicians are assembling the equipment on site.

sentences.hanzi: 最近作业压力有点大，大家都需要调整节奏。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 jin4 zuo4 ye4 ya1 li4 you3 dian3 da4, da4 jia1 dou1 xu1 yao4 tiao2 zheng3 jie2 zou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 최근 작업 압박이 좀 커서 모두가 리듬을 조정할 필요가 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Recently the work pressure has been a bit high, and everyone needs to adjust their pace.

meaningEn: to sit for a long time

sentences.hanzi: 坐得久了，起来活动一下会更舒服。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 de5 jiu3 le5, qi3 lai2 huo2 dong4 yi2 xia4 hui4 geng4 shu1 fu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 오래 앉아 있었으면 일어나서 조금 움직이는 편이 더 편하다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you have been sitting for a long time, it feels better to get up and move around a little.

sentences.hanzi: 请你确认一下作证内容是否准确。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ni3 que4 ren4 yi2 xia4 zuo4 zheng4 nei4 rong2 shi4 fou3 zhun3 que4.
sentences.meaningKo: 증언 내용이 정확한지 한번 확인해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please confirm whether the content of the testimony is accurate.

meaningEn: to give a reply; to make a response

sentences.hanzi: 相关部门已经就这个问题做出了正式答复。
sentences.pinyin: xiang1 guan1 bu4 men2 yi3 jing1 jiu4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 zuo4 chu1 le5 zheng4 shi4 da2 fu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 관련 부서는 이 문제에 대해 이미 정식 답변을 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The relevant department has already given an official reply on this issue.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动由组长负责安排具体流程。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 an1 pai2 ju4 ti3 liu2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 활동은 조장이 구체적인 절차 배치를 책임진다.
sentences.meaningEn: For this activity, the group leader is responsible for arranging the specific process.

sentences.hanzi: 他作风踏实，做事从来不浮躁。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 feng1 ta4 shi2, zuo4 shi4 cong2 lai2 bu4 fu2 zao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 태도가 착실해서 일을 할 때 한 번도 들뜨거나 경솔하지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is steady and down-to-earth in style, and he is never impetuous in doing things.

sentences.hanzi: 从这里到机场的坐车时间大概是四十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 li3 dao4 ji1 chang3 de5 zuo4 che1 shi2 jian1 da4 gai4 shi4 si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 여기서 공항까지 차로 이동하는 시간은 대략 40분이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The travel time by car from here to the airport is about forty minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 老师会在下节课前完成作业检查。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 hui4 zai4 xia4 jie2 ke4 qian2 wan2 cheng2 zuo4 ye4 jian3 cha2.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 다음 수업 전에 과제 검사를 마칠 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher will complete the assignment checking before the next class.

meaningEn: working people; person doing the groundwork
meaningKo: 실무를 하는 사람; 일을 하는 사람

sentences.hanzi: 真正辛苦的，往往是那些在背后做工作的人。
sentences.pinyin: zhen1 zheng4 xin1 ku3 de5, wang3 wang3 shi4 na4 xie1 zai4 bei4 hou4 zuo4 gong1 zuo4 de5 ren2.
sentences.meaningKo: 정말 힘든 사람들은 대개 뒤에서 실무를 하는 사람들이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Those who are truly hardworking are often the people doing the groundwork behind the scenes.

sentences.hanzi: 这次专题的组稿质量整体上比去年更高。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zhuan1 ti2 de5 zu3 gao3 zhi4 liang4 zheng3 ti3 shang4 bi3 qu4 nian2 geng4 gao1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 특집의 모집 원고 품질은 전체적으로 작년보다 더 높다.
sentences.meaningEn: Overall, the quality of the solicited manuscripts for this special issue is higher than last year.

meaningEn: to sit back in one's original seat

sentences.hanzi: 讨论结束后，请大家坐回原位。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 jie2 shu4 hou4, qing3 da4 jia1 zuo4 hui2 yuan2 wei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 토론이 끝난 뒤에는 모두 원래 자리로 돌아가 앉아 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: After the discussion ends, please return to your original seats.

sentences.hanzi: 请先看清作答要求，再开始答题。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 xian1 kan4 qing1 zuo4 da2 yao1 qiu2, zai4 kai1 shi3 da2 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 먼저 답안 작성 요구 사항을 분명히 확인한 뒤 문제를 풀기 시작하세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please first read the answering requirements carefully before beginning to answer the questions.

sentences.hanzi: 只要肯做出努力，就一定会有收获。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ken3 zuo4 chu1 nu3 li4, jiu4 yi2 ding4 hui4 you3 shou1 huo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 기꺼이 노력하기만 하면 반드시 얻는 것이 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as one is willing to make efforts, there will definitely be gains.

sentences.hanzi: 这项任务能顺利完成，离不开组员合作。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xiang4 ren4 wu5 neng2 shun4 li4 wan2 cheng2, li2 bu4 kai1 zu3 yuan2 he2 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 임무가 순조롭게 완수될 수 있었던 것은 조원 협력 덕분이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The smooth completion of this task depended on the cooperation among the team members.

sentences.hanzi: 去那座小岛最好坐船去。
sentences.pinyin: qu4 na4 zuo4 xiao3 dao3 zui4 hao3 zuo4 chuan2 qu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그 작은 섬에 가려면 배를 타고 가는 것이 가장 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: To go to that small island, it is best to go by boat.

meaningKo: 작풍이 저자세다; 태도가 낮고 드러내지 않는다

sentences.hanzi: 他作风低调，很少在公开场合表现自己。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 feng1 di1 diao4, hen3 shao3 zai4 gong1 kai1 chang3 he2 biao3 xian4 zi4 ji3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 태도가 낮고 드러내지 않아서 공개석상에서 자신을 드러내는 일이 드물다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is low-key in style and rarely shows himself off in public.

sentences.hanzi: 负责人已经就后续工作做出了安排。
sentences.pinyin: fu4 ze2 ren2 yi3 jing1 jiu4 hou4 xu4 gong1 zuo4 zuo4 chu1 le5 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 책임자는 후속 업무에 대해 이미 배치를 해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The person in charge has already made arrangements for the follow-up work.

sentences.hanzi: 只要组内沟通顺畅，很多问题都能提前解决。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 nei4 gou1 tong1 shun4 chang4, hen3 duo1 wen4 ti2 dou1 neng2 ti2 qian2 jie3 jue2.
sentences.meaningKo: 조 내 소통이 원활하기만 하면 많은 문제를 미리 해결할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as communication within the team is smooth, many problems can be solved in advance.

sentences.hanzi: 请把相关作证文件一并提交上来。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ba3 xiang1 guan1 zuo4 zheng4 wen2 jian4 yi2 bing4 ti2 jiao1 shang4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 관련 증빙 문서를 함께 제출해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please submit the relevant supporting documents together.

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等，不如主动去问清楚。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 qu4 wen4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 기다리기보다는 스스로 적극적으로 물어보는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting, it is better to take the initiative to ask clearly.

meaningEn: to do things in an orderly way; organized in one’s work

sentences.hanzi: 她做事有条理，所以总能把事情安排得很好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 tiao2 li3, suo3 yi3 zong3 neng2 ba3 shi4 qing2 an1 pai2 de5 hen3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 조리 있게 해서 항상 일을 아주 잘 배치할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: She does things in an orderly way, so she can always arrange matters very well.

meaningEn: to have a stable routine; stable work-rest schedule

sentences.hanzi: 最近他的作息稳定多了，精神状态也好了不少。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 jin4 ta1 de5 zuo4 xi1 wen3 ding4 duo1 le5, jing1 shen2 zhuang4 tai4 ye3 hao3 le5 bu4 shao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 최근 그의 생활 리듬이 훨씬 안정되어 정신 상태도 많이 좋아졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: Recently his routine has become much more stable, and his mental state has improved a lot as well.

meaningKo: 작풍이 강단 있다; 태도가 단호하고 시원시원하다

sentences.hanzi: 他作风硬朗，处理问题从不拖泥带水。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 feng1 ying4 lang3, chu3 li3 wen4 ti2 cong2 bu4 tuo1 ni2 dai4 shui3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 태도가 강단 있어서 문제를 처리할 때 질질 끄는 법이 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is firm and forthright in style and never drags his feet when handling problems.

sentences.hanzi: 在开始之前，先把这次的作业目标明确下来。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, xian1 ba3 zhe4 ci4 de5 zuo4 ye4 mu4 biao1 ming2 que4 xia4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 이번 작업 목표를 먼저 분명히 정해 두자.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, let us first clarify the objective of this assignment.

meaningEn: chaired by the group leader; group leader presides

sentences.hanzi: 今天的讨论由组长主持，大家依次发言。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 tao3 lun4 you2 zu3 zhang3 zhu3 chi2, da4 jia1 yi1 ci4 fa1 yan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 오늘 토론은 조장이 주관하니 모두 차례대로 발언해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Today's discussion will be chaired by the group leader, and everyone should speak in turn.

sentences.hanzi: 如果时间充裕，坐火车去也不错。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi2 jian1 chong1 yu4, zuo4 huo3 che1 qu4 ye3 bu2 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간이 넉넉하다면 기차를 타고 가는 것도 괜찮다.
sentences.meaningEn: If time is sufficient, going by train is also a good option.

meaningEn: to produce results; to achieve成果

sentences.hanzi: 只要方法得当，早晚都能做出成果。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 fang1 fa3 de2 dang4, zao3 wan3 dou1 neng2 zuo4 chu1 cheng2 guo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 방법만 적절하면 결국에는 성과를 낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the method is appropriate, results can be achieved sooner or later.

sentences.hanzi: 不同题型有不同的作答方式，要先看清要求。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 tong2 ti2 xing2 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 zuo4 da2 fang1 shi4, yao4 xian1 kan4 qing1 yao1 qiu2.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제 유형마다 답변 방식이 다르니 먼저 요구 사항을 분명히 봐야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Different question types have different answering methods, so you should first read the requirements carefully.

meaningEn: compositional approach; train of thought for composing

sentences.hanzi: 他的作曲思路很清晰，所以写起来特别顺。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 si1 lu4 hen3 qing1 xi1, suo3 yi3 xie3 qi3 lai2 te4 bie2 shun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작곡 구상은 매우 분명해서 곡을 쓸 때 특히 막힘이 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: His compositional approach is very clear, so writing music goes especially smoothly for him.

sentences.hanzi: 别坐得太久，起来活动一下对身体更好。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 zuo4 de5 tai4 jiu3, qi3 lai2 huo2 dong4 yi2 xia4 dui4 shen1 ti3 geng4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 너무 오래 앉아 있지 말고 일어나 조금 움직이는 것이 몸에 더 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not sit for too long; getting up and moving a bit is better for your health.

sentences.hanzi: 组稿通知发布以后，来稿数量明显增加了。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 gao3 tong1 zhi1 fa1 bu4 yi3 hou4, lai2 gao3 shu4 liang4 ming2 xian3 zeng1 jia1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 원고 모집 공지가 발표된 뒤 투고 수가 눈에 띄게 늘어났다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the call-for-papers notice was released, the number of submissions increased noticeably.

sentences.hanzi: 他做事果断，所以在紧急情况下很靠得住。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 guo3 duan4, suo3 yi3 zai4 jin3 ji2 qing2 kuang4 xia4 hen3 kao4 de5 zhu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일 처리가 과단성이 있어서 긴급한 상황에서 매우 믿을 만하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is decisive in doing things, so he is very dependable in emergencies.

sentences.hanzi: 根据现场情况，作战计划调整得很及时。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 xian4 chang3 qing2 kuang4, zuo4 zhan4 ji4 hua4 tiao2 zheng3 de5 hen3 ji2 shi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 현장 상황에 따라 작전 계획 조정이 매우 제때 이루어졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: According to the situation on site, the operational plan was adjusted in a very timely manner.

sentences.hanzi: 等组员到齐以后，我们就正式开始。
sentences.pinyin: deng3 zu3 yuan2 dao4 qi2 yi3 hou4, wo3 men5 jiu4 zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원이 모두 도착하면 우리는 정식으로 시작할 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Once all the team members have arrived, we will officially begin.

sentences.hanzi: 想到什么就先坐下来写下来，别总拖着。
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 shen2 me5 jiu4 xian1 zuo4 xia4 lai2 xie3 xia4 lai2, bie2 zong3 tuo1 zhe5.
sentences.meaningKo: 생각난 것이 있으면 먼저 앉아서 써 두고 자꾸 미루지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: If you think of something, sit down and write it down first instead of always putting it off.

meaningEn: with a very solid style; tough and reliable in conduct
meaningKo: 작풍이 매우 강단 있다; 태도가 믿음직스럽다

sentences.hanzi: 这支队伍作风过硬，执行任务很有纪律。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhi1 dui4 wu5 zuo4 feng1 guo4 ying4, zhi2 xing2 ren4 wu5 hen3 you3 ji4 lv4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 팀은 태도가 매우 강단 있고 임무 수행에도 규율이 잘 서 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: This team has a very solid style and carries out tasks with strong discipline.

meaningEn: to admit; to make an acknowledgment

sentences.hanzi: 面对事实，他最终还是做出了承认。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 shi4 shi2, ta1 zui4 zhong1 hai2 shi4 zuo4 chu1 le5 cheng2 ren4.
sentences.meaningKo: 사실을 마주하고 그는 결국 인정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Faced with the facts, he ultimately made an admission.

sentences.hanzi: 整个作证过程都被完整记录了下来。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 zuo4 zheng4 guo4 cheng2 dou1 bei4 wan2 zheng3 ji4 lu4 le5 xia4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 증언 과정은 모두 완전하게 기록되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The entire testimony process was completely recorded.

sentences.hanzi: 这把椅子坐得很舒服，适合长时间办公。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ba3 yi3 zi5 zuo4 de5 hen3 shu1 fu5, shi4 he2 chang2 shi2 jian1 ban4 gong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 의자는 앉기에 매우 편해서 장시간 사무를 보기에 적합하다.
sentences.meaningEn: This chair is very comfortable to sit in and is suitable for long hours of office work.

sentences.hanzi: 根据组员反馈，我们对方案做了进一步修改。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zu3 yuan2 fan3 kui4, wo3 men5 dui4 fang1 an4 zuo4 le5 jin4 yi2 bu4 xiu1 gai3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원 피드백에 따라 우리는 방안을 한층 더 수정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Based on feedback from the team members, we made further revisions to the plan.

sentences.hanzi: 他做事讲原则，所以大家都很信服他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 jiang3 yuan2 ze2, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 xin4 fu2 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 원칙을 지키기 때문에 모두가 그를 신뢰하고 따른다.
sentences.meaningEn: He acts according to principles, so everyone trusts and respects him.

meaningEn: work record form; assignment log sheet

sentences.hanzi: 请把今天的情况填写在作业记录表上。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ba3 jin1 tian1 de5 qing2 kuang4 tian2 xie3 zai4 zuo4 ye4 ji4 lu4 biao3 shang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 오늘 상황을 작업 기록표에 작성해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please fill in today's situation on the work record form.

sentences.hanzi: 坐在前面的人看得更清楚一些。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 qian2 mian4 de5 ren2 kan4 de5 geng4 qing1 chu3 yi4 xie1.
sentences.meaningKo: 앞에 앉아 있는 사람들이 좀 더 선명하게 볼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Those sitting in front can see a bit more clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 大家最好先弄清楚组长要求，再开始行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zui4 hao3 xian1 nong4 qing1 chu3 zu3 zhang3 yao1 qiu2, zai4 kai1 shi3 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 조장의 요구 사항을 분명히 파악한 뒤 행동을 시작하는 것이 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone had better first understand the group leader's requirements clearly before taking action.

sentences.hanzi: 只要坚持下去，总能慢慢做出成果来。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 jian1 chi2 xia4 qu4, zong3 neng2 man4 man4 zuo4 chu1 cheng2 guo3 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 계속 꾸준히 하기만 하면 결국에는 조금씩 성과를 낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as you keep at it, you will gradually be able to produce tangible results.

meaningEn: work speed; pace of doing the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 提高作业速度的同时，也要保证质量。
sentences.pinyin: ti2 gao1 zuo4 ye4 su4 du4 de5 tong2 shi2, ye3 yao4 bao3 zheng4 zhi4 liang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 속도를 높이는 동시에 품질도 보장해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: While increasing work speed, quality must also be ensured.

meaningEn: to sit there in a daze

sentences.hanzi: 别总坐在那里发呆，先把手头的事做完。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 zong3 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 fa1 dai1, xian1 ba3 shou3 tou2 de5 shi4 zuo4 wan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 늘 멍하니 거기 앉아 있지 말고 먼저 손에 잡힌 일을 끝내라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not just sit there in a daze; first finish what is at hand.

sentences.hanzi: 经过多次讨论后，组员意见终于统一了。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 ci4 tao3 lun4 hou4, zu3 yuan2 yi4 jian4 zhong1 yu2 tong3 yi1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 차례 토론한 끝에 조원 의견이 마침내 하나로 모였다.
sentences.meaningEn: After many discussions, the team members' opinions finally became unified.

meaningEn: serious and responsible in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事认真负责，因此深受大家信赖。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 ren4 zhen1 fu4 ze2, yin1 ci3 shen1 shou4 da4 jia1 xin4 lai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 성실하고 책임감 있게 해서 모두의 깊은 신뢰를 받는다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is serious and responsible in doing things, so she is deeply trusted by everyone.

sentences.hanzi: 队伍已经进入高度戒备的作战状态。
sentences.pinyin: dui4 wu5 yi3 jing1 jin4 ru4 gao1 du4 jie4 bei4 de5 zuo4 zhan4 zhuang4 tai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 팀은 이미 고도의 경계 작전 상태에 들어갔다.
sentences.meaningEn: The team has already entered a highly alert operational state.

sentences.hanzi: 忙了这么久，你先坐下休息一会儿吧。
sentences.pinyin: mang2 le5 zhe4 me5 jiu3, ni3 xian1 zuo4 xia4 xiu1 xi5 yi2 hui4 er5 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이렇게 오래 바빴으니 먼저 앉아서 잠깐 쉬어라.
sentences.meaningEn: You have been busy for so long, so sit down and rest for a while first.

meaningEn: to have a good and regular routine

sentences.hanzi: 只要作息规律良好，学习和工作的状态都会更稳定。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 xi1 gui1 lv4 liang2 hao3, xue2 xi2 he2 gong1 zuo4 de5 zhuang4 tai4 dou1 hui4 geng4 wen3 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 생활 리듬이 좋고 규칙적이기만 하면 학습과 업무 상태가 모두 더 안정적이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as one has a good and regular routine, both study and work performance become more stable.

meaningEn: to come up with a response; to make a response

sentences.hanzi: 面对突然的提问，他很快就做出回应来了。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 tu1 ran2 de5 ti2 wen4, ta1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 zuo4 chu1 hui2 ying4 lai2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 갑작스러운 질문을 받았지만 그는 곧바로 대응해 냈다.
sentences.meaningEn: When faced with a sudden question, he quickly came up with a response.

sentences.hanzi: 合理的作业分配能大大减少重复劳动。
sentences.pinyin: he2 li3 de5 zuo4 ye4 fen1 pei4 neng2 da4 da4 jian3 shao3 chong2 fu4 lao2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 합리적인 작업 배분은 중복 노동을 크게 줄일 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Reasonable task allocation can greatly reduce duplicated effort.

meaningEn: for the group leader to send a notice

sentences.hanzi: 有新安排的话，组长会第一时间发通知。
sentences.pinyin: you3 xin1 an1 pai2 de5 hua4, zu3 zhang3 hui4 di4 yi1 shi2 jian1 fa1 tong1 zhi1.
sentences.meaningKo: 새로운 배치가 생기면 조장이 가장 먼저 공지를 보낼 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: If there is a new arrangement, the group leader will send a notice right away.

sentences.hanzi: 坐在后面的人可能会听得不太清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 hou4 mian4 de5 ren2 ke3 neng2 hui4 ting1 de5 bu2 tai4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 뒤에 앉아 있는 사람들은 잘 못 들을 수도 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: People sitting in the back may not hear very clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 根据老师的意见，我们对初稿做出了修改。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 lao3 shi1 de5 yi4 jian4, wo3 men5 dui4 chu1 gao3 zuo4 chu1 le5 xiu1 gai3.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님의 의견에 따라 우리는 초고를 수정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Based on the teacher’s comments, we made revisions to the first draft.

sentences.hanzi: 每个人都要明确自己在作战任务中的职责。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 yao4 ming2 que4 zi4 ji3 zai4 zuo4 zhan4 ren4 wu5 zhong1 de5 zhi2 ze2.
sentences.meaningKo: 각자는 작전 임무 속에서 자신의 책임을 분명히 해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone must clearly understand their responsibilities in the operational mission.

meaningEn: team members gather; team member assembly

sentences.hanzi: 请通知所有组员集合，马上开始说明任务。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 tong1 zhi1 suo3 you3 zu3 yuan2 ji2 he2, ma3 shang4 kai1 shi3 shuo1 ming2 ren4 wu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 모든 조원에게 집합하라고 알려서 곧바로 임무 설명을 시작해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please notify all team members to gather so we can start explaining the task right away.

meaningKo: 작업 습관이 좋다; 공부 습관이 좋다

sentences.hanzi: 他作业习惯良好，所以很少拖延。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 ye4 xi2 guan4 liang2 hao3, suo3 yi3 hen3 shao3 tuo1 yan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 작업 습관이 좋아서 미루는 일이 거의 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has good work habits, so he rarely procrastinates.

sentences.hanzi: 她做事细心，所以大家都愿意和她合作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 xi4 xin1, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4 he2 ta1 he2 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 세심하게 해서 모두가 그녀와 협력하기를 원한다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is careful in doing things, so everyone is willing to work with her.

sentences.hanzi: 他一紧张就会不自觉地坐得很直。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 jin3 zhang1 jiu4 hui4 bu4 zi4 jue2 di5 zuo4 de5 hen3 zhi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 긴장하면 무의식적으로 아주 똑바로 앉게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Whenever he gets nervous, he unconsciously sits very straight.

sentences.hanzi: 开会以后，组长会统一安排任务。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 yi3 hou4, zu3 zhang3 hui4 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 ren4 wu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의가 끝난 뒤 조장이 통일적으로 임무를 배정할 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the meeting, the group leader will assign tasks in a unified way.

meaningEn: answer content; content of the response

sentences.hanzi: 请再次确认一下你的作答内容是否完整。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 zai4 ci4 que4 ren4 yi2 xia4 ni3 de5 zuo4 da2 nei4 rong2 shi4 fou3 wan2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 당신의 답안 내용이 완전한지 다시 한번 확인해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please confirm once again whether your answer content is complete.

sentences.hanzi: 根据反馈意见，我们已经做出了不少改进。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 fan3 kui4 yi4 jian4, wo3 men5 yi3 jing1 zuo4 chu1 le5 bu4 shao3 gai3 jin4.
sentences.meaningKo: 피드백 의견에 따라 우리는 이미 적잖은 개선을 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Based on the feedback, we have already made quite a few improvements.

meaningEn: time is tight for the task

sentences.hanzi: 这次作业时间紧，大家要提高效率。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 shi2 jian1 jin3, da4 jia1 yao4 ti2 gao1 xiao4 lv4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 작업은 시간이 촉박하니 모두 효율을 높여야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: This time the task schedule is tight, so everyone needs to improve efficiency.

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐着看，不明白的地方等会儿再问。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 kan4, bu4 ming2 bai2 de5 di4 fang1 deng3 hui4 er5 zai4 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 앉아서 보고 이해되지 않는 부분은 이따가 다시 물어라.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit and watch first, and ask later about anything you do not understand.

sentences.hanzi: 具体安排请以组委会通知为准。
sentences.pinyin: ju4 ti3 an1 pai2 qing3 yi3 zu3 wei3 hui4 tong1 zhi1 wei2 zhun3.
sentences.meaningKo: 구체적인 배치는 조직위원회 공지를 기준으로 해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please take the organizing committee’s notice as the standard for the specific arrangements.

sentences.hanzi: 等大家意见一致了，再把这件事做成决定。
sentences.pinyin: deng3 da4 jia1 yi4 jian4 yi2 zhi4 le5, zai4 ba3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 zuo4 cheng2 jue2 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두의 의견이 일치하면 그때 이 일을 최종 결정으로 확정하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Once everyone’s opinions are unified, we can then finalize the decision on this matter.

sentences.hanzi: 他作风稳健，很少因为冲动而出错。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 feng1 wen3 jian4, hen3 shao3 yin1 wei4 chong1 dong4 er2 chu1 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 태도가 안정적이고 신중해서 충동 때문에 실수하는 일이 드물다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is steady and prudent in style and rarely makes mistakes due to impulsiveness.

meaningEn: to sit beside; to sit by the side

sentences.hanzi: 你就坐在旁边听，暂时不用发言。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 zuo4 zai4 pang2 bian1 ting1, zan4 shi2 bu2 yong4 fa1 yan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 그냥 옆에 앉아 듣고 당분간 발언하지 않아도 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Just sit beside us and listen; for now you do not need to speak.

meaningEn: situation of team members; member status

sentences.hanzi: 组长需要及时了解每位组员情况。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 xu1 yao4 ji2 shi2 liao3 jie3 mei3 wei4 zu3 yuan2 qing2 kuang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장은 각 조원의 상황을 제때 파악해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The group leader needs to understand each team member’s situation in a timely manner.

sentences.hanzi: 老师已经多次做出提醒，大家不要再迟到了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 yi3 jing1 duo1 ci4 zuo4 chu1 ti2 xing3, da4 jia1 bu2 yao4 zai4 chi2 dao4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님이 이미 여러 차례 주의를 주셨으니 모두 더 이상 지각하지 마세요.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher has already given reminders many times, so everyone should stop being late.

sentences.hanzi: 只要思路清楚，大部分题都能作答正确。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 si1 lu4 qing1 chu3, da4 bu4 fen4 ti2 dou1 neng2 zuo4 da2 zheng4 que4.
sentences.meaningKo: 생각의 흐름만 분명하면 대부분의 문제는 정확하게 답할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as your thinking is clear, most questions can be answered correctly.

sentences.hanzi: 他的作曲速度很快，但质量也一直保持得不错。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 su4 du4 hen3 kuai4, dan4 zhi4 liang4 ye3 yi4 zhi2 bao3 chi2 de5 bu2 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작곡 속도는 매우 빠르지만 품질도 계속 꽤 잘 유지되고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: His speed of composition is very fast, yet the quality has also remained quite good.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for a reply

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐等回复，不如主动再联系一次。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 deng3 hui2 fu4, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 zai4 lian2 xi4 yi2 ci4.
sentences.meaningKo: 답장만 기다리기보다는 스스로 한 번 더 연락하는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than just waiting for a reply, it is better to take the initiative and contact them once more.

meaningEn: division of tasks among team members

sentences.hanzi: 组员任务分工越明确，合作起来越顺畅。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 yuan2 ren4 wu5 fen1 gong1 yue4 ming2 que4, he2 zuo4 qi3 lai2 yue4 shun4 chang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원 임무 분담이 명확할수록 협력이 더 원활해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: The clearer the division of tasks among team members, the smoother the cooperation becomes.

sentences.hanzi: 只要时间允许，我们总能做出安排来。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 shi2 jian1 yun3 xu3, wo3 men5 zong3 neng2 zuo4 chu1 an1 pai2 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간만 허락되면 우리는 늘 배치를 마련해 낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as time permits, we can always work out arrangements.

sentences.hanzi: 正式开始前，先把这周的作业计划列出来。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3 qian2, xian1 ba3 zhe4 zhou1 de5 zuo4 ye4 ji4 hua4 lie4 chu1 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 정식으로 시작하기 전에 이번 주 작업 계획을 먼저 적어 보자.
sentences.meaningEn: Before officially starting, first list out this week’s work plan.

meaningEn: to sit aside; to sit to one side

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在一边等一下，我马上过来。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 yi4 bian1 deng3 yi2 xia4, wo3 ma3 shang4 guo4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 한쪽에 앉아 잠깐 기다려라, 내가 곧 갈게.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit to one side and wait a moment first; I will come over right away.

meaningEn: not careless in doing things; meticulous
meaningKo: 일할 때 대충 하지 않다; 꼼꼼하다

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不马虎，所以交给他的任务都很让人放心。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 ma3 hu5, suo3 yi3 jiao1 gei3 ta1 de5 ren4 wu5 dou1 hen3 rang4 ren2 fang4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 대충 하지 않아서 그에게 맡긴 임무는 모두 매우 안심이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is not careless in doing things, so any task assigned to him is very reassuring.

meaningEn: approach to answering; line of reasoning for answering
meaningKo: 답안 풀이 방향; 답변 사고 흐름

sentences.hanzi: 这道题先别急着写，先把作答思路理清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 ti2 xian1 bie2 ji2 zhe5 xie3, xian1 ba3 zuo4 da2 si1 lu4 li3 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 문제는 먼저 서둘러 쓰지 말고 답안 풀이 방향부터 분명히 정리해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not rush to write this question; first sort out your approach to answering clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 做出安排后，大家就按计划分头行动。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 an1 pai2 hou4, da4 jia1 jiu4 an4 ji4 hua4 fen1 tou2 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 배치를 마친 뒤 모두는 계획에 따라 나누어 행동했다.
sentences.meaningEn: After making the arrangements, everyone acted separately according to the plan.

sentences.hanzi: 如果安排不合理，就会明显增加大家的作业负担。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 an1 pai2 bu4 he2 li3, jiu4 hui4 ming2 xian3 zeng1 jia1 da4 jia1 de5 zuo4 ye4 fu4 dan1.
sentences.meaningKo: 배치가 합리적이지 않으면 모두의 과제 부담이 눈에 띄게 커진다.
sentences.meaningEn: If the arrangement is unreasonable, it will noticeably increase everyone’s workload burden.

meaningEn: the group leader holds a meeting

sentences.hanzi: 遇到重要问题时，组长会先开会统一意见。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 zhong4 yao4 wen4 ti2 shi2, zu3 zhang3 hui4 xian1 kai1 hui4 tong3 yi1 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 중요한 문제가 생기면 조장은 먼저 회의를 열어 의견을 통일한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When important issues arise, the group leader first holds a meeting to unify opinions.

sentences.hanzi: 你坐在中间吧，这样看得更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zuo4 zai4 zhong1 jian1 ba5, zhe4 yang4 kan4 de5 geng4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 가운데에 앉아라, 그러면 더 잘 보일 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit in the middle; that way you will be able to see more clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 在正式动笔之前，他先确定了整首曲子的作曲方向。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zheng4 shi4 dong4 bi3 zhi1 qian2, ta1 xian1 que4 ding4 le5 zheng3 shou3 qu3 zi5 de5 zuo4 qu3 fang1 xiang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 정식으로 쓰기 전에 그는 먼저 곡 전체의 작곡 방향을 정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before formally writing, he first determined the compositional direction of the whole piece.

meaningEn: to be拖拉 in doing things; to procrastinate

sentences.hanzi: 做事太拖拉，往往会错过最好的时机。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 tai4 tuo1 la1, wang3 wang3 hui4 cuo4 guo4 zui4 hao3 de5 shi2 ji1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일을 너무 질질 끌면 대개 가장 좋은 시기를 놓치게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you procrastinate too much in doing things, you will often miss the best opportunity.

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业要求明确，大家做起来就不会太乱。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 ming2 que4, da4 jia1 zuo4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 tai4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 과제 요구 사항만 명확하면 모두가 해 나갈 때 그다지 혼란스럽지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the assignment requirements are clear, everyone will not be too confused while doing it.

sentences.hanzi: 大家坐着聊天的时候，也顺便把问题讨论清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zuo4 zhe5 liao2 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4, ye3 shun4 bian4 ba3 wen4 ti2 tao3 lun4 qing1 chu3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 앉아서 이야기를 나누는 동안 문제도 겸사겸사 분명히 토론해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: While everyone sat and chatted, they also took the opportunity to discuss the issue clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 新项目启动前，要先做好组员培训。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xiang4 mu4 qi3 dong4 qian2, yao4 xian1 zuo4 hao3 zu3 yuan2 pei2 xun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 새 프로젝트를 시작하기 전에 먼저 조원 교육을 잘 해 두어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting a new project, training for the team members should be done well first.

sentences.hanzi: 只要肯踏实干，每个人都能做出贡献来。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ken3 ta4 shi2 gan4, mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 neng2 zuo4 chu1 gong4 xian4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 착실하게 일하기만 하면 누구나 실질적인 공헌을 할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as one works steadily, everyone can make a real contribution.

meaningEn: work plan sheet; assignment schedule table

sentences.hanzi: 请把本周的作业计划表发到群里共享。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ba3 ben3 zhou1 de5 zuo4 ye4 ji4 hua4 biao3 fa1 dao4 qun2 li3 gong4 xiang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 주 작업 계획표를 단체방에 올려 공유해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please send this week’s work plan sheet to the group chat for sharing.

sentences.hanzi: 他一听到那段旋律，就觉得作曲灵感来了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 ting1 dao4 na4 duan4 xuan2 lv4, jiu4 jue2 de5 zuo4 qu3 ling2 gan3 lai2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 그 선율을 듣자마자 작곡 영감이 떠올랐다고 느꼈다.
sentences.meaningEn: As soon as he heard that melody, he felt that inspiration for composition had come.

meaningEn: to sit there blankly; to sit in a daze

sentences.hanzi: 别一个人坐着发愣，快过来一起想办法。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhe5 fa1 leng4, kuai4 guo4 lai2 yi4 qi3 xiang3 ban4 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 혼자 멍하니 앉아 있지 말고 빨리 와서 같이 방법을 생각해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not sit there blankly by yourself; come over quickly and think of a solution together.

meaningEn: group leader's reminder; the group leader reminds

sentences.hanzi: 多亏组长提醒，我们才没有漏掉关键步骤。
sentences.pinyin: duo1 kui1 zu3 zhang3 ti2 xing3, wo3 men5 cai2 mei2 you3 lou4 diao4 guan1 jian4 bu4 zhou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 상기시켜 준 덕분에 우리는 중요한 단계를 빠뜨리지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: Thanks to the group leader’s reminder, we did not miss the key steps.

sentences.hanzi: 内容不必太复杂，但作答一定要完整。
sentences.pinyin: nei4 rong2 bu2 bi4 tai4 fu4 za2, dan4 zuo4 da2 yi2 ding4 yao4 wan2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 내용이 너무 복잡할 필요는 없지만 답안은 반드시 완전해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The content does not need to be too complicated, but the answer must be complete.

sentences.hanzi: 她做事有耐心，所以特别适合处理细致的工作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 nai4 xin1, suo3 yi3 te4 bie2 shi4 he2 chu3 li3 xi4 zhi4 de5 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 참을성이 있어서 세밀한 업무를 처리하는 데 특히 잘 맞는다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is patient in doing things, so she is especially suited to handling meticulous work.

meaningEn: work arrangement chart; assignment schedule sheet

sentences.hanzi: 新的作业安排表已经贴在办公室门口了。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 de5 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 biao3 yi3 jing1 tie1 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 men2 kou3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 새로운 작업 배치표는 이미 사무실 문 앞에 붙어 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The new work arrangement chart has already been posted at the office door.

sentences.hanzi: 她喜欢坐在窗边，一边看书一边晒太阳。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 chuang1 bian1, yi4 bian1 kan4 shu1 yi4 bian1 shai4 tai4 yang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 창가에 앉아 책을 읽으며 햇볕을 쬐는 것을 좋아한다.
sentences.meaningEn: She likes sitting by the window, reading a book while enjoying the sunshine.

sentences.hanzi: 项目推进顺利，离不开组员协作。
sentences.pinyin: xiang4 mu4 tui1 jin4 shun4 li4, li2 bu4 kai1 zu3 yuan2 xie2 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 프로젝트가 순조롭게 추진된 것은 조원 협업 덕분이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The smooth progress of the project depends on collaboration among the team members.

sentences.hanzi: 在证据充分之前，不要轻易做出结论。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zheng4 ju4 chong1 fen4 zhi1 qian2, bu2 yao4 qing1 yi4 zuo4 chu1 jie2 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 증거가 충분해지기 전에는 쉽게 결론을 내려서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before the evidence is sufficient, one should not draw conclusions lightly.

sentences.hanzi: 为了确保安全，必须严格遵守作业程序。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 que4 bao3 an1 quan2, bi4 xu1 yan2 ge2 zun1 shou3 zuo4 ye4 cheng2 xu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 안전을 확보하기 위해 반드시 작업 절차를 엄격히 준수해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To ensure safety, the operating procedure must be strictly followed.

meaningEn: to sit in the last row

sentences.hanzi: 他总喜欢坐在最后一排，安静地听讲。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 zui4 hou4 yi4 pai2, an1 jing4 di5 ting1 jiang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 늘 맨 뒷줄에 앉아 조용히 수업을 듣는 것을 좋아한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He always likes to sit in the last row and listen quietly to the lesson.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for coordination

sentences.hanzi: 遇到分歧时，由组长负责协调最合适。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 fen1 qi2 shi2, you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 xie2 tiao2 zui4 he2 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 의견 차이가 있을 때는 조장이 조정을 책임지는 것이 가장 적절하다.
sentences.meaningEn: When differences arise, it is most appropriate for the group leader to take charge of coordination.

meaningEn: serious in style; conscientious in manner

sentences.hanzi: 他作风认真，因此很少出现低级错误。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 feng1 ren4 zhen1, yin1 ci3 hen3 shao3 chu1 xian4 di1 ji2 cuo4 wu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 태도가 진지해서 낮은 수준의 실수가 거의 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is conscientious in manner, so low-level mistakes rarely occur.

meaningEn: to give an assurance; to make a guarantee

sentences.hanzi: 如果没有把握，就不要轻易做出保证来。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 ba3 wo4, jiu4 bu2 yao4 qing1 yi4 zuo4 chu1 bao3 zheng4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 확신이 없으면 쉽게 보장을 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you are not sure, do not make assurances lightly.

sentences.hanzi: 进入现场的作业人员必须佩戴安全装备。
sentences.pinyin: jin4 ru4 xian4 chang3 de5 zuo4 ye4 ren2 yuan2 bi4 xu1 pei4 dai4 an1 quan2 zhuang1 bei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 현장에 들어가는 작업 인원은 반드시 안전 장비를 착용해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Working personnel entering the site must wear safety equipment.

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐着休息一下，等会儿再继续。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 xiu1 xi5 yi2 xia4, deng3 hui4 er5 zai4 ji4 xu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 앉아서 조금 쉬고 이따가 다시 계속해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit and rest for a while first, and continue later.

meaningEn: group leader's speech; the group leader speaks

sentences.hanzi: 组长讲话的时候，大家都安静地听着。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 jiang3 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4, da4 jia1 dou1 an1 jing4 di5 ting1 zhe5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 말할 때 모두가 조용히 듣고 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: When the group leader was speaking, everyone listened quietly.

meaningEn: not to procrastinate in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 只要养成做事不拖延的习惯，效率就会提高很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 yang3 cheng2 zuo4 shi4 bu4 tuo1 yan2 de5 xi2 guan4, xiao4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 ti2 gao1 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일을 미루지 않는 습관만 들이면 효율이 훨씬 높아진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as you develop the habit of not procrastinating, your efficiency will improve a lot.
